text:
Sophia R.: FYI — billing-bot flagged INV-2026-452 for BrightLayer. Invoice creation is blocked until we receive an official PO number and the company's EU VAT ID. Procurement also noted our PO template is missing a 'cost center' and their vendor registration code.

Harold - BrightLayer: we uploaded a PO last week (ref BR-PO-3345) but procurement rejected the format — they require a clear 'Purchase Order' header and a 6-digit cost center. Can you accept a scanned PDF? I can resend in the exact format they want.

Sophia R.: We can accept a scanned PO as long as it contains an official PO number and the VAT registration in the correct format. Finance needs VAT like `IE1234567V` (for Ireland) or the appropriate country code. Also confirm the supplier legal name on the PO matches the invoice. Our billing record shows billing_country=IE so VAT is required.

Harold - BrightLayer: confirmed IE. VAT is IE1234567V. Procurement also wants the supplier legal name to be 'BrightLayer Ltd' on the invoice — can you ensure that?

Jordan V. (Sales Ops): I've asked the account team to update the customer legal name to 'BrightLayer Ltd' in the system and added a cost center field on the account. Priya, once the customer uploads the PO I can prepare a proforma for them to route internally.

Priya K. (Finance): Quick clarity: we cannot finalize or send an official invoice until we have the customer's PO and VAT in their procurement format. If procurement needs a proforma to approve internally, we can issue a labelled proforma ("Proforma — not an invoice") so they can route it. Once the PO is attached and validated, we'll issue the invoice same day. Harold — please attach the PO to Zendesk ticket #7892 or drop it here as a PDF.

Harold - BrightLayer: Uploaded PO PDF to Zendesk #7892 just now. Filename: BR-PO-3345_costcenter_123456.pdf. VAT included (IE1234567V).

Sophia R.: Received. Quick scan: PO has cost center and VAT, but header says 'Order Confirmation' instead of 'Purchase Order' — finance may still accept it but tagging Jordan to confirm.

Jordan V. (Sales Ops): I reviewed the uploaded doc — procurement will accept it as long as PO number, cost center, VAT, and legal name are present. Good to proceed.

Priya K. (Finance): Running the final validation now: PO number present (BR-PO-3345), cost center = 123456, legal name matches 'BrightLayer Ltd', VAT = IE1234567V. Marking cleared. Will issue invoice INV-2026-452 by EOD. billing-bot, create invoice and email to billing@brightlayer.com.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-452 created and queued for email to billing@brightlayer.com (proforma=false).

Sophia R.: Closing loop — procurement confirmed after proforma routing, invoice scheduled. Harold, let us know if you need a different remit-to or additional tax breakdowns. :thumbsup: (reaction :thumbsup: by Jordan V.)

Harold - BrightLayer: Thanks everyone — we see the queued invoice and will confirm when payment is released. :pray:
